items.evidence: Log shows 40 uL aspirated from beads A1 and dispensed into each of 96 wells, followed by 10 aspirate/dispense mix cycles of 70 uL; incubation comment is recorded before the magnet comment.
Engage-magnet/wait comment precedes 96 x 90 uL supernatant removals to waste A1, then two rounds of 200 uL ethanol added and 200 uL removed to waste for every well.
Comments for 5 min air dry, magnet disengage, and 2 min incubation then re-engage are present; 50 uL water is added per well with 10 mix cycles in the log.
Log lines 6530-6911 show 45 uL aspirated from each sample well and dispensed into the same-named elution_plate well (A1->A1 ... H12->H12).
Every well in supernatant removal, ethanol removal and elution gets its own pick up/drop tip pair in the log, with no tip reuse across samples.

judge.summary: The protocol performs all pipetting steps correctly per the simulator log, with correct volumes, 10x mixes, and well-to-well identity preservation. Manual steps (incubations, magnet, drying) are recorded as comments at the right points and a fresh tip is used for every well.
